cohort: 56 infertile women with submucous uterine fibroids who underwent hysteroscopic myomectomy, compared to a control group of 63 women who underwent hysteroscopic polypectomy
finding: Hysteroscopic myomectomy was associated with increased pregnancy rates and good reproductive outcomes in infertile women with submucous fibroids.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rate was 5.4% amongst women who had a hysteroscopic myomectomy.
